payload.summary: scope: the deterministic game-state engine. Deck of 6 suspects / 6 weapons / 9 rooms; setup draws the case file triple and deals the remaining 18 round-robin; room adjacency graph; turn state machine (move then optional suggest); suggestion validation and token relocation; clockwise refutation search returning which player refutes and which card is shown privately; accusation adjudication against the case file with wrong-accusation elimination that keeps the accuser refuting; win/loss. Pure logic over an explicit state value — no network, no LLM, no I/O. Unit-tested without an API key. Blocks game-master and cli-ui.
